name: Spine Shelf
summary: A writer's site menu as a bookshelf: pull a spine and the book flies to the stand and opens on that page
about: Each section of a writer's website is a cloth-bound book on a walnut shelf. Pick a spine and it dips, slides up out of the row and flies down to the reading stand, turning from a spine into a cover on the way, while the open book closes and flies home to its slot. It lands with a puff of dust, the cover swings open with a little overshoot and the page writes itself in; the books beside the empty slot lean into the gap.
how: Click or tap a spine to open that section on the stand.
Tab to the shelf, move with the arrow keys, Home or End, then press Enter.
On Write to Me, type a letter and press Seal and send; an empty letter shakes.
Press Reading lamp to switch the warm light off and on.
A demo pulls a few books by itself until you click, tap or press a key.
